dependency_warnings.issue_description: The code change uses '@angular/material/legacy-core' which indicates usage of legacy Angular Material components. Legacy components were deprecated in Angular Material 15 and removed in Angular Material 17. This will cause runtime errors in Angular 20.
resolution_steps: Step 1: Update @angular/material to version 20.x.x using 'ng update @angular/material'
Step 2: Replace all legacy component imports (e.g., '@angular/material/legacy-core') with their modern equivalents (e.g., '@angular/material/core')
Step 3: Update component selectors in templates from legacy versions (mat-legacy-*) to modern versions (mat-*)
Step 4: Review and update any custom styling that targets legacy component classes

dependency_warnings.issue_description: Angular CDK must be compatible with Angular Material version. If Angular Material is updated to v20, CDK must also be updated to v20 to avoid version conflicts and API incompatibilities.
resolution_steps: Step 1: Update @angular/cdk to version 20.x.x using 'ng update @angular/cdk'
Step 2: Review CDK breaking changes documentation for v20
Step 3: Test all CDK-dependent functionality (drag-drop, overlay, etc.)

dependency_warnings.issue_description: ngx-logger may not be compatible with Angular 20. Many versions of ngx-logger were built for much older Angular versions and may not support the latest Angular 20 features, Ivy renderer changes, and updated TypeScript versions. This could cause build failures or runtime errors.
resolution_steps: Step 1: Check current ngx-logger version in package.json
Step 2: Update to ngx-logger version 5.0.12 or later which supports Angular 15+
Step 3: If no compatible version exists, consider migrating to Angular's built-in logging or alternative libraries like @ngx-toolkit/logger
Step 4: Test logging functionality thoroughly after upgrade
Step 5: Update any custom log configurations to match new API if breaking changes exist
